integrity: All complex-root assertions proved from exact Möbius factorization and equality in the positive-coefficient triangle bound; Lambert-W error derives from an explicit logarithmic equation. Finite checks are corroborative, not proofs of infinite quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two distinct prime divisors; innermost nonzero complex roots only; asymptotic at fixed smaller prime and larger prime tending to infinity. No claim about all outer roots or uniform two-prime asymptotics. Priority screened against identified literature, not independently guaranteed.
title: The exact innermost nonzero zero circle of two-prime necklace polynomials
